summary: Seeded the .seventwos upstream policy/state/path-map/invariants system for usr-workspace-android.

Diagnosed root cause of startup_failure on all push-triggered workflow runs against develop (Test, APK Build, Code Quality Checks): the repository's GitHub Actions allowed-actions policy is set to 'selected' with patterns_allowed [astral-sh/*, dorny/*, Azure/*, azure/*, codecov/*, dependabot/*] and verified_allowed=false. tests.yml/build.yml/quality.yml use third-party actions not covered by this list (jlumbroso/free-disk-space, nschloe/action-cached-lfs-checkout, webfactory/ssh-agent, gradle/actions/setup-gradle), so GitHub refuses to start those jobs. The Graphify workflow is unaffected because it only uses actions already covered by the allow-list, which is why it ran to completion (and failed at runtime, not startup) while the others failed at startup with 0s duration.
evidence: gh run list --limit 15 (all push@develop runs conclusion=startup_failure, 0s duration)

summary: Attempted to repair the PR validation baseline by expanding the repo-level actions/permissions/selected-actions allow-list to cover the actions already pinned-by-SHA in existing workflows (actions-ecosystem, gradle-update, gradle, jlumbroso, ludeeus, nschloe, peaceiris, peter-evans, reactivecircus, webfactory, zizmorcore). The API call was rejected with HTTP 409: 'Selected actions and workflows are already set at the organization or enterprise level.' This confirms the allow-list is enforced above the repository and cannot be repaired from within this repository; it requires an org/enterprise administrator. Recorded as a blocker rather than worked around by disabling or rewriting the affected checks.
